params.topic: Veikkausliiga 2019-2025 row-level official round and venue evidence, plus 2026 regular-season row-level validation
questions: Return row-level evidence for every unresolved 2019-2025 fixture official_round, fixture identity, kickoff, venue, and city. Include 2026 regular-season rounds 1-22 only when row-level evidence is available.
Explicitly exclude 2026 continuation rounds 23-32 (about 45 fixtures) from the requested audit, missing count, and unresolved queue. Do not fetch or report them as required work.

Use official Veikkausliiga schedule/archive and/or Palloliitto Tulospalvelu as primary sources. WorldFootball may cross-check only when the round grouping is explicit. Preserve published KIERROS labels for postponed matches; never infer official_round from date order, CSV row order, scores, standings, odds, or team occurrence count.

For every returned row include competition_key, season, fixture_key, date, kickoff, kickoff_timezone, home_team, away_team, official_round, venue, city, status, source_name, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256, and evidence_notes. Preserve NULL fields and list unresolved rows.

Do not infer meeting_number, first/second meeting, double_round_robin, Qimen charts, palaces, relations, odds, probabilities, Outcome, Review, Gold, or model conclusions. If no authoritative meeting_number definition exists, return NULL/unavailable with the reason.

Return audit totals separately for the in-scope target (2019-2025 plus 2026 regular season rounds 1-22) and the excluded 2026 continuation rounds 23-32. The excluded continuation count must not increase the in-scope missing count.

in_scope_prior_unresolved: 2026 regular-season rounds 1-22 row-level evidence where page-level evidence is currently partial

notes: Evidence-only supplement. This supersedes the scope of req-20261006-002 for current gap accounting by excluding 2026 continuation rounds 23-32; it does not delete or rewrite the earlier request. meeting_number remains NULL/unavailable unless an explicit authoritative definition is found.
